I'm interested in gaming trends because sometimes they show where the industry is moving. If Battlefront's population deflates quickly, it could stand out to the industry as a warning that even a pretty game with good IP will fail if there's not enough substance behind it. It's similar to what happened to Evolve, except that was more of a warning against pervasive microtransations and having too many balancing issues at launch.

I know that there are always going to be lackluster games around, but when a big game fails in a specific way it makes other publishers switch gears for a while. That's why I'm curious to see if Battlefront keeps its momentum into next year or fizzles out by next holiday season.
